attempts.tactics: Killed entry guard at optic, routed west around low cover, recovered Mara, traversed north to Sera, attempted east recovery under fire.
failures: Held E at 10m/8m before sufficiently close.
East receiver remained 6–7m away behind cover; failed approach and died under interceptor fire.
Last shooting burst did not save attempt.

attempts.tactics: Killed entry guard, chose east-first approach, used prompted vault to pass entry cover, recovered Elian, tried moving north-west to Heart.
failures: Repeated Heart recovery failed at edge of floor ring.
Stationary recovery attempts sustained heavy fire.
Shift without held movement dashed forward away from receiver rather than simply defending; died after failed recovery.

noticed: Shift phase dash / break nearby charges

learning: Entry announcement explicitly teaches amber-charge counter and optic aiming; two critical kills in attempt 1 support basic discoverability.
Contextual low-cover crouch and clear-landing vault prompts are useful; vault was used successfully.
Map identifies walls, low cover, receivers, current position, jammer and extraction.
Move closer / step inside floor ring teaching arrived near receivers; exact proximity remained costly to judge during fire.

strengths: Strong cohesive rainy teal/amber presentation, large mission title and clear typography.
World archive signage, objective distance and map support routing.
Deaths preserve recovered names and show clear retry action and statistics.
Enemy optics and charging captions provide readable threat/counter cues.
obstacles: Many small HUD labels compete with scene and world signs; minimap and archive signs can overlap visually.
Selected Mara objective stayed selected while deliberately approaching Elian/Heart, so distant objective label was less helpful for local receiver distance.
Cover interrupted intended travel several times.
Rear/flank threats and repeated failed recoveries drained health before I understood exact reachable ring.
Enemies are visibly blocky and environment repeats simple cover/structural forms; presentation exceeds geometry/animation richness.

coverage_gaps: No Custodian/jammer fight or confirmed boss damage/disables
score_rationale: Readable, coherent vertical slice with useful contextual teaching and strong mood. Two honest failed runs show routing/proximity and combat-under-recovery friction. Limited observed encounter/asset richness and missing end-to-end coverage do not support AAA readiness.
